First I'll need to figure out when tomorrow is. If today is Monday 29th July, tomorrow will be July 30th. So I'll check for any events on the user's calendar for July 30th..... I only found one event, "Train Trip to Chicago" at 15:07. The user mentioned going to Chicago earlier, and this event is about travelling to Chicago. This must be a match for the event the user wants to delete.

With the user's confirmation, I will delete the event "Train Trip to Chicago" on July 30th 2024 at 15:07 from the user's calendar.
